question: Should `isReplySessionInitConflictError` become a supported permanent public Plugin SDK contract rather than remain an internal reply-runtime detail?
rationale: The code can centralize the implementation mechanically, but maintainers must decide whether external plugins should be allowed to depend on this specific error-classification behavior and its compatibility burden.

options.title: Approve the focused SDK contract
options.body: Accept the predicate as a supported `error-runtime` API after fresh current-head behavior proof confirms the channel retry outcome.

options.title: Keep the classifier internal
options.body: Retain one core-owned classifier for bundled callers and remove the new public SDK export if maintainers do not want to support it for external plugins.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept the predicate as a supported `error-runtime` API after fresh current-head behavior proof confirms the channel retry outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: Their feature history is directly connected to the guarded reply-session initialization boundary whose conflict semantics this API exposes.
